checks.question: Are the subject matter, duration, nature and purpose of the processing, the types of personal data and the categories of data subjects specified (Art. 28(3) GDPR)?
Does the processor process personal data only on documented instructions of the controller, including for international transfers (Art. 28(3)(a))?
Are persons authorised to process the data committed to confidentiality (Art. 28(3)(b))?
Are technical and organisational measures under Art. 32 required and described (e.g. in an annex)?
Is engaging sub-processors subject to prior specific or general written authorisation, with notice of changes and a right to object (Art. 28(2),(4))?
Must the processor assist the controller with data subject requests (Art. 28(3)(e))?
Must the processor notify personal data breaches, and within what time?
Must the processor delete or return all personal data at the end of the services (Art. 28(3)(g))?
Does the controller have audit and inspection rights, and does the processor provide the information needed to demonstrate compliance (Art. 28(3)(h))?
Are transfers outside the EEA addressed (adequacy decision, standard contractual clauses, transfer impact assessment)?
How is liability between controller and processor allocated, and is it capped?
